modeAutoTitle.message: Arrange chat automatically to fit the window

separateTitle.message: Open official chat in a separate window

errorPopupBlocked.message: The chat window could not open. Check this site’s popup settings.

errorVideoMissing.message: No video found yet. Start the stream, then try again.

errorPipUnsupported.message: This browser does not support the always-on-top window. Use Twitch’s regular popout instead.

pipPlaceholder.message: Playing in the always-on-top window · Close that window to return the video here

statusPlayerReplaced.message: Twitch updated the player, so the video was returned. Once playback settles, choose “Popout (always on top)” in the player settings again.

errorPipOpen.message: The always-on-top window could not open. Try the button again or use Twitch’s regular popout.

statusPageUpdated.message: The video was returned because the Twitch page updated.

errorChatEmbed.message: The site blocked embedded chat. Use “Chat window” to open official chat separately.

helpOpenInstruction.message: On a Twitch live channel page, click the player’s settings gear.

helpNativeInstruction.message: Choose “Popout” for a regular window or “Popout (always on top)” for an always-on-top window.

helpLayoutInstruction.message: Choose the chat layout at the top of the small window.

helpKeepTabInstruction.message: Keep the original Twitch tab open while using the always-on-top window. Closing, reloading or navigating away from the original tab also closes the small window.

helpRestoreNote.message: Closing the small window returns the video to the original tab.

helpReloadNote.message: If the menu item is missing, reload the regular Twitch live channel page.

helpUnofficial.message: An unofficial extension, not provided or endorsed by Twitch.

consentEnabled.message: Enabled. You can use it on Twitch live channel pages.

consentSaveError.message: Could not save your settings. Please try again.

onboardingSummary.message: Adds official chat to Twitch popouts.

consentQuestion.message: May the extension load and display Twitch’s official chat?

consentLocalUse.message: Information from the live channel page needed for display is used on your device and is not sent to the developer.

consentStored.message: Only display settings and your consent choice are stored on your device.

consentAgreement.message: Review this information and choose “Enable” if you agree.

consentDeferred.message: The extension is still disabled. You can enable it from this page at any time.

documentPipNote.message: The always-on-top window uses Document Picture-in-Picture. This does not add chat to standard video-only PiP.

popupHint.message: Review the initial consent information and manage settings on the dedicated page.

errorOpenSettings.message: Could not open the settings page. Please try again.
